subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A student used an image from a museum website in a report but forgot to give credit.”?
options: One student said the game made him want to learn what was real.
One student said, "A good apology should not be the end.
A student said, "But we did not control everything."
The student said, "But I did not steal the real painting."

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One student said the game made him want to learn what was real.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One student said, 'A good apology should not be the end.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A student said, 'But we did not control everything.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The student said, 'But I did not steal the real painting.'」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The student said, 'But I did not steal the real painting.'」，答案為「The student said, 'But I did not steal the real painting.'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The student said, 'But I did not steal the real painting.'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
